description: Golden questions for the knowledge base in src/main/resources/docs/kb. Answerable questions must retrieve a chunk of the expected source that contains at least one expected phrase. Out-of-scope questions must retrieve nothing that passes the relevance gates. GoldenSetTest checks every phrase against the real chunking, so editing a doc cannot silently break this file. Replace these with questions about YOUR documents.

questions.question: How many days do I have to return an item after delivery?
questions.referenceAnswer: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery; the window starts on the delivery date.

questions.question: How long until a card refund appears after the warehouse receives the item?
expectedPhrases: within 5 to 10 business days after the warehouse receives the item
questions.referenceAnswer: Card refunds appear within 5 to 10 business days after the warehouse receives the item.

questions.question: When can support approve a partial refund?
questions.referenceAnswer: Only when AllowPartialRefund = true is set on the order, for items returned damaged, used or missing parts.

questions.question: Who pays for return shipping on a defective item?
expectedPhrases: Return shipping is free for defective or wrong items
questions.referenceAnswer: Return shipping is free for defective or wrong items; otherwise a 6 dollar label fee is deducted.

questions.question: How long does express shipping take and what does it cost?
expectedPhrases: Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days
questions.referenceAnswer: Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days and costs 15 dollars.

questions.question: Which orders ship free?
questions.referenceAnswer: Orders over 50 dollars ship free with Standard shipping.

questions.question: When is a package treated as lost?
expectedPhrases: the package is treated as lost
questions.referenceAnswer: When tracking shows no movement for 7 days.

questions.question: Can I change the shipping address after the order ships?
questions.referenceAnswer: No. The address can be changed only while the order is PROCESSING.

questions.question: How long is the prepaid return label valid?
expectedPhrases: The label is valid for 14 days
questions.referenceAnswer: The prepaid return label is valid for 14 days.

questions.question: Can a shipped order still be cancelled?
expectedPhrases: Once it is SHIPPED it cannot be cancelled
questions.referenceAnswer: No. Once it is shipped it cannot be cancelled; wait for delivery and start a return.

questions.question: What does the error RETURN_WINDOW_EXPIRED mean?
expectedPhrases: the delivery date is more than 30 days ago
questions.referenceAnswer: The delivery date is more than 30 days ago, so the item can no longer be returned.

questions.question: How long does the warehouse take to inspect a returned item?
expectedPhrases: inspects the item within 2 business days of arrival
questions.referenceAnswer: The warehouse inspects the item within 2 business days of arrival.

questions.question: What is the capital of France?
How do I bake sourdough bread?
Describe quantum entanglement in plain language.
